# Penpact

> Penpact is an open-source, developer-first, embeddable e-signature API: the open DocuSign
> alternative. Self-host the core engine under AGPL-3.0 or use the managed cloud. It ships a typed
> TypeScript SDK, AI field detection (Claude), an append-only audit trail, a PAdES digital signature
> on the sealed PDF, and a SHA-256 Certificate of Completion. Pricing is usage-based with no
> per-seat or per-page billing.

## Status

Penpact is in early development (v0.1.0, June 2026). The API is not stable yet, the consent text is
pending legal review, and the default PAdES certificate is self-signed unless you supply your own.

## Key facts

- License: AGPL-3.0 (core engine). Managed cloud is a paid tier.
- Self-host: `docker compose up` starts Postgres and the API and prints a working API key.
- Compliance: captures intent, electronic-records consent (US ESIGN Act 15 U.S.C. §7001(c)),
  attribution (email and IP), and integrity (SHA-256 plus PAdES). Targets simple electronic
  signatures under US ESIGN/UETA and EU eIDAS. Does not yet support EU qualified signatures (QES).
- SDK: `@penpact/sdk` (TypeScript), create/upload/place-fields/send/download.
- Repository: https://github.com/penpact/penpact

## Docs

- [Open-source DocuSign alternative](https://penpact.dev/open-source-docusign-alternative): what
  Penpact is and how it compares to DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, DocuSeal, and Documenso.
- [Penpact vs DocuSign API](https://penpact.dev/penpact-vs-docusign): pricing, embedding, SDK,
  AI field detection, compliance, and when to pick which.
- [Embed e-signatures in Next.js](https://penpact.dev/embed-e-signatures-nextjs): create envelopes
  from a route handler, place fields, send, and handle webhooks.
- [Add e-signatures to React](https://penpact.dev/embed-e-signatures-react): call your backend from
  React and send signers to the signing link.
